statement.en: Definitions of the frozen corpus written in the grammar hold for every carrier and relation: the 墨经's and 荀子's 化 are one form and are 成坏 along 缘, 同 is a class where each belongs to one and one only (shown sufficient; necessity is not shown), and continuation is neither identity nor mere difference.
statement.zh: 冻结语料中的定义写入文法后，对每个载体与关系成立：墨经与荀子之化同形，是沿缘之成坏；同在各属唯一时为类（只证其为充分）；续非一非异。

laws.en: 化, read from the 墨经 (「化，徵易也」) and the 荀子 (「状变而实无别而为异者，谓之化」), is one form: continuing under the class of the thing while the class of its marks tells the two apart, which is the grammar's alteration.
laws.zh: 墨经（「化，徵易也」）与荀子（「状变而实无别而为异者，谓之化」）之化同为一形：在其物之类下续，而其征之类分之，即文法之异。

laws.en: 成坏, read from the 金师子章 (「諸根合會是成相，諸緣各住自位是壞相」), is at once alike under a coarse class and apart under a fine one; 化 is 成坏 along 缘.
laws.zh: 金师子章之成坏（「諸根合會是成相，諸緣各住自位是壞相」）是一时之中在粗类下同、在细类下异；化是沿缘之成坏。

laws.en: 同, read from the 墨经 (「同，異而俱於之一也」), is sameness in belonging to one; it is a class where each belongs to one and one only (shown sufficient; necessity is not shown), and otherwise need not be transitive.
laws.zh: 墨经之同（「同，異而俱於之一也」）是同属于一；在各属唯一时为类（只证其为充分，未证必要），否则不必传递。

laws.en: 复, read from the 老子 (「復命曰常」), is a line returning to where it was; what returns abides. 通, read from the 系辞 (「往來不窮謂之通」) with 往來 read as a relation and its converse, is going and coming without end: the line from an occurrence never ends along 缘, nor along its converse. Under a constant class a line with a past never ends going; where the class is constant both ways, an occurrence with a predecessor passes through, what abides being a case; constancy one way is not enough (counting up from zero); under the one, day and night go and come without end.
laws.zh: 老子之复（「復命曰常」）是线之返其所始；复者住。系辞之通（「往來不窮謂之通」），以往来为一关系与其逆：往与来皆不穷，即自一事起之线沿缘不终，沿其逆亦不终。有常之类下，有前之线往而不穷；类于缘与其逆两向皆有常时，有前者通，住者是其一例；一向有常不足（自零计数）；在“一”之下，昼夜往来不穷。

laws.en: Neither one nor other: in a net without self-conditioning there is no continuation under identity, and every 缘 is a continuation under some class while identity tells its ends apart. The 中论's 「滅更不生故，因即為斷滅」 holds under identity while the same 缘 is a continuation under a coarser class.
laws.zh: 非一非异：无自缘之网中，相等之类下无续，而每一缘在某类下为续、其两端为相等所分。中论「滅更不生故，因即為斷滅」在相等之类下成立，而同一缘在较粗之类下为续。

hypotheses.en: Each reading of a sentence as a definition is an AI reconstruction following the commentary named in the classification; the sense lost in it is recorded in the plan.
hypotheses.zh: 把一句读作定义，是依分类中所注之注疏的 AI 重构；其中失去之义记于计划。

hypotheses.en: Equality on the carrier is a model commitment where identity is the class.
hypotheses.zh: 以相等为类之处，载体之相等是模型的承诺。

does_not_show.en: That these readings are the texts' own sense: the 墨经's 化 is also one of six kinds of action, and the 金师子章's 成坏 is read synchronically against the 中论's 「成壞相違，云何一時有」.
does_not_show.zh: 这些读法即文本自身之义：墨经之化又是六种为之一；金师子章之成坏以共时读之，与中论「成壞相違，云何一時有」相对。

does_not_show.en: That the 中论's dilemma is answered: whether a condition must still be present when what it conditions arises is not expressible without a relation of co-presence, which the grammar lacks.
does_not_show.zh: 中论之两难已答：缘在其所缘生时是否须仍在，没有同在之关系便不能表达，而文法没有。

does_not_show.en: That every kind of 同 in the 墨经 is a class: 類同 is not transitive by itself.
does_not_show.zh: 墨经之每种同都是类：类同本身不传递。

detail.en: Belonging to two: 0 and 1 share 10, 1 and 2 share 20, 0 and 2 share nothing («同于不必传递»).
detail.zh: 属于二者：0 与 1 同属 10，1 与 2 同属 20，0 与 2 无所同属（«同于不必传递»）。

validation_scope.en: Checked by the core checker with Lean 4.29.1 from the prelude: Becoming.GrammarReadings, 13 theorems in 18 declarations, each with an empty axiom report. The sentences come from the frozen first-batch corpus as classified by four Opus coders; no human audit. The OU6 corrections were reviewed against the Lean by GPT astra and Opus reviewers.
validation_scope.zh: 由核心检查器以 Lean 4.29.1 从前奏检查：Becoming.GrammarReadings，18 个声明中 13 条定理，公理报告皆空。句子来自冻结之第一批语料，经四位 Opus 编者分类；尚无人审核之记录。OU6 之更正经 GPT astra 与 Opus 审查者对照 Lean 审查。

next_delta.en: Write the rest of the corpus's 517 definitional units in the grammar where they read relationally, and prove the 59 grammar-theorem candidates or show where they fail.
next_delta.zh: 把语料 517 个定义单元中能以关系读之者写入文法，并证明 59 个文法定理之候选，或示其不成之处。

correspondence.en: Units: 墨经 MJ-J-045, MJ-J-039; 荀子 XZ-ZM-063, XZ-ZM-064; 金师子章 JSZ-P-08-003; 老子 LZ-16-005; 系辞 「往來不窮謂之通」; 中论 ZL-21-122, ZL-01 (青目 「若一則無緣，若異則無相續」). The 墨经's four kinds of 同 (MJ-S-089) and the 中论's refutations are registered with the classification.

detail.en: Continuation, alteration, lines, constancy and the identity class are the grammar's.
detail.zh: 续、异、线、有常与相等之类皆出自文法。

output.en: «续», «异», «相续», «有常», «有常则续不尽», «任一缘可为续».
output.zh: «续»、«异»、«相续»、«有常»、«有常则续不尽»、«任一缘可为续»。

conditions.en: A net without self-conditioning where identity is the class.
conditions.zh: 以相等为类处，网中无自缘。

history.en: 23 October 2026, board item OU2 (study section 372): the first definitions of the frozen corpus written in the grammar, after the classification of the first batch.
history.zh: 2026年10月23日，工作板条目 OU2（研究第 372 节）：第一批语料归类之后，首批定义写入文法。

history.en: 25 October 2026, board item OU6 (corrections to the grammar from the review of its sources, study section 400): 通 defined with its 往來, going along 缘 and coming along its converse, so that constancy one way no longer gives it («有常则通» renamed «有常则往不穷», for what it shows); the statement and the sentence on 同 narrowed to the sufficiency the theorem shows. The claim is narrowed where a name or a reading said more than the Lean, and the new theorems are added; no other law changes.
history.zh: 2026年10月25日，工作板条目 OU6（据对文法与其来源之审所作之更正，研究第 400 节）：通依其往来而定义，往沿缘、来沿其逆，故一向有常不再得通（«有常则通» 依其所示改名为 «有常则往不穷»）；陈述与同之一句收窄为定理所示之充分。凡名或读法说过了 Lean 者，论断收窄；新定理增入；其余之律不变。

history.en: 1 November 2026, board item OU7 (study section 492): law 4 generalized, as the corpus's family of 通 needed (conditional-laws-of-the-corpus): where a class is constant both ways, what has a predecessor passes through («两向有常有前则通»); «两向有常则通», for what abides, is proved as its case, its statement unchanged. The law and the GrammarReadings.lean reference gain 1 declaration; the validation scope's counts are receipt 20261101T094230.205342Z's. Nothing else the record states changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月1日，工作板条目 OU7（研究第 492 节）：律 4 推广，为语料之通之族所需（conditional-laws-of-the-corpus）：类两向有常时，有前者通（«两向有常有前则通»）；«两向有常则通»（住者）证为其一例，陈述不变。律与 GrammarReadings.lean 之引用增 1 声明；验证范围之数目为收据 20261101T094230.205342Z 者。记录所述余无改变。
